description:
How many aircraft of a manufacturer, model or type are on a national register?

Counts marks on the register snapshot matching the filters and returns the count, the
filters as applied (field and match mode), the manufacturer strings that matched, the top
manufacturer/model combinations and, for the US, the FAA status codes in the result with
their meanings. `manufacturer` and `model` match the register's own text: `match` is
`contains` (default, substring) or `exact` (whole value, case-insensitive). Manufacturer
names vary by era on one register (PILATUS AIRCRAFT LTD vs PILATUS FLUGZEUGWERKE AG), so
call register_list_types first to see the strings, then count. `icao_type` (e.g. PC12) works
on the Swiss register only, the one that records it; elsewhere the answer is `unsupported`.
`country` takes a code (US, CH, FR), a name or a nationality prefix (N, HB, F).


Registers held: US (FAA Releasable Aircraft Database), CH (Swiss register, FOCA) and FR (French register, DGAC), each as one dated snapshot named in `provenance.edition` -- not today's register. Other countries answer `not_held`, never zero. `status` (the argument) is registered (default: the register's own current status; for the FAA, MASTER.txt codes V, M and T, the ones the FAA's documentation calls valid), deregistered, all, or for the US `other` or raw FAA status codes such as 'V,M'. Raw FAA codes select from MASTER.txt only: DEREG.txt keeps a cancelled mark's LAST status, so a 'V' there is not a valid registration. Text filters are literal and case-insensitive; % and _ are ordinary characters. Reading the answer: `status` is resolved, none_matched (the register snapshot holds nothing matching -- about this register only), not_held, unsupported (the register does not record the field asked about; nothing was guessed), unresolved (the input could not be used; the note says why) or unavailable. Where a register asks to be credited, `provenance.attribution` and a note carry the wording: quote it with the figure.
name: register_fleet_count
title: Count aircraft on a register
